Canada, Dominica, Zambia, Fiji are Commonwealth; Eritrea and test pool are not. No post-2023 changes.
Air Canada, Air China, Copa, Air India are Star Alliance; Atlas Air and test pool are not.

Overlap note: the Australia Group CW-precursor list contains dimethyl phosphite, methyldiethanolamine, thionyl chloride and also DF (methylphosphonyl difluoride) while excluding HN2, so it disagrees with the label on DF in the test pool.
Triethanolamine, POCl3, cyanogen chloride, HCN are Schedule 3; ricin, sulfur mustard (Sch1), amiton (Sch2) and the rest are not Schedule 3.
G7 values correct; no changes.
American, Qatar, Qantas, Finnair are oneworld; Air Zimbabwe, Air Europa (SkyTeam), and the rest are not.

UV-328 was listed in Annex A at COP-11 (May 2023) and the amendment entered into force only after Oct 2023 (2024). Other values correct: PCBs, alpha-HCH, BDEs in Annex A; TCDD Annex C only; methamidophos and polychlorinated terphenyls are Rotterdam, not Stockholm.
GB, BD, VC, GM (rejoined 2018) are members; SI and test pool are not. GS (South Georgia) is a UK overseas territory, not itself a member; intended label is defensible.

SAS left Star Alliance on 31 Aug 2024 and joined SkyTeam on 1 Sep 2024; it is correctly a non-member as of Oct 2026 but its status changed after Oct 2023. Other values correct (Edelweiss is Lufthansa Group but not a member).
Edinburgh, Copenhagen, Utrecht, Helsinki are on leru.org/members (24 members; ETH Zurich joined Jan 2024, not in pool). Bologna, Bristol and others are not LERU.
IT, ME, MK, BG are NATO; MT and the test pool are not. FK (Falklands) is a UK territory outside NATO's treaty area; intended label defensible.

DE, LI, CH, MT are Schengen; IE is not. Cyprus is still outside Schengen as of Oct 2026 (Commission positive assessment July 2026, Council decision pending; accession expected 2027), so status may change soon. FO (Faroe) is outside Schengen.
Founders (1997): Lufthansa, SAS, Thai, Air Canada, United. ANA joined 1999. Note SAS left the alliance in 2024 but remains a founding member historically.

Hoa Sen and Lyceum of the Philippines are AUN associate members, not core members (AUN has 30 core and ~165 associate members, with associates added every year). The class therefore depends on the growing associate roster; the better-known 'AUN core members' list would exclude P_M[0]. NUS and Airlangga are core members.
BN, LA, MM, PH are ASEAN (Myanmar is excluded from summit-level representation but remains a member). Timor-Leste joined Oct 2025 but is not in this pool.
Ethiopia, Iran and UAE became BRICS members on 1 Jan 2024 (after Oct 2023). Benin and test pool are not members or partners.

Office LTSC Professional Plus 2021 includes Skype for Business, whose executable is lync.exe; Skype.exe is consumer Skype (retired May 2025), not an Office LTSC app. Other members (EXCEL, OUTLOOK, ONENOTE) correct.

'Microsoft server product port assignments' is not an authoritative closed list. Microsoft's own 'Service overview and network port requirements for Windows' also lists 593 (RPC over HTTP endpoint mapper) and 162 (SNMP Trap), which are test non-members here.
de, li, ch, mt Schengen; ie not. Cyprus still outside Schengen as of Oct 2026 but accession pending.

de, il, cl, cr (joined 2021) are OECD; my and mt are not. Bulgaria and Croatia are in late-stage OECD accession (Croatia targeted mid-2026); I could not confirm they remain non-members as of Oct 2026, so their status is in flux.

'Microsoft productivity applications' is ad hoc: Skype.exe (N_p) is itself a Microsoft communication app and msfeedssync.exe is a Microsoft component. Teams' current executable is ms-teams.exe. Skype was retired in May 2025.
'Plaintext application protocol ports' is not a closed list. 1433 (SQL Server TDS) is plaintext unless TLS is configured, so its test label is debatable; 3269 is LDAP-over-TLS (non-member, fine).
fr, jp, gb, us are G7; tr not. Note the UK's operative ccTLD is .uk; .gb is reserved/unused.
CA, BB, TV, NG Commonwealth; RO and test pool not.
Brussels, ANA, Copa, Shenzhen are Star Alliance; Eurowings, Air France, Mandarin and others are not.

Scandium is not conventionally part of the yttrium group (yttrium earths = Y plus Gd/Tb through Lu); it is usually treated separately. The grouping boundary is also not closed (two-group vs three-group schemes; Eu and Gd vary).

SAS joined SkyTeam on 1 Sep 2024 (after Oct 2023). SkyTeam lists SAS as the member; SAS Link is a regional subsidiary operating under SAS, so its membership is only via affiliation. Other values correct (Transavia and Air France-KLM Cargo are not SkyTeam members).

Values are consistent with the two-group scheme (Gd-Lu + Y vs La-Eu), but the yttrium group boundary is not fixed: gadolinium is placed in the light/middle group in some schemes and europium in a middle 'terbium group' in the three-group scheme.
IT, SA, IN, AR are G20; MU and test pool are not.

NATO values correct.

Climate Alliance has ~2,000 member municipalities and the roster changes continuously; it is not a well-known closed list. Berlin, Batumi, Kreuzlingen, Basel confirmed on the May 2026 member list; I could not verify the non-membership of Rotterdam (N_p) or Leeuwarden.

Saudi Arabia's BRICS status is disputed: invited in 2023, listed by BRICS/India materials as one of 11 members, but Riyadh still describes itself as an 'invited country' as of 2026. A, P_M and test pool are correct (BRICS-5 nested grouping agrees on test pool).
TN, SD, SY, IQ are Arab League members. Syria was suspended 2011 and readmitted May 2023 (before the Oct 2023 window). NG, SS and test pool are not members.
US, Hong Kong China, Chinese Taipei, PNG are APEC economies; MU and test pool are not.
CNNJI (Nanjing), INMAA, RULED, BRSSZ are in original BRICS states; AUADL and test pool are not. No new-member countries in the pool.

AX (Aland Islands) is an autonomous part of Finland and lies inside the EU and EEA, so labelling it a non-member is wrong under a territorial reading. Other values correct (CH is not EEA; MS is a UK territory).
All four are European Cup winners; Dinamo Zagreb and test pool have never won.

Volkswagen Pref was deleted from the EURO STOXX 50 effective 21 Sep 2026, so it is not a constituent in Oct 2026. Deutsche Bank was re-added in Sep 2025 and Kering was removed in June 2025 (replaced by Rheinmetall), both changes after Oct 2023.
CA, TZ, KI, LK Commonwealth; ES and test pool not. SH (St Helena) is a UK territory, not itself a member.
Inter, Monterrey, Al Ahly, Palmeiras played the 2025 Club World Cup; Shakhtar, Sporting CP, Arsenal and the rest did not.
Real Madrid, PSV, Dortmund, Porto were G-14 founders; Man City and test pool were never members. Overlapping 'European Cup winners' is excluded by Man City (2023 winner).

Microsoft, Travelers, Disney, Honeywell are DJIA members. Honeywell stays in the Dow after its 2026 Aerospace spin-off under the new name Honeywell Technologies (post-2023 rename). Alphabet replaced Verizon June 2026 (not in pool). PepsiCo and test pool are not constituents.
EU values correct.
Inter, Arsenal, Tottenham, Atletico were among the 12 founding clubs (April 2021); Bayern and test pool were not.

TMR (Algeria), PMV/CUP/GDO (Venezuela) are in OPEC states; SAL (El Salvador) and test pool are not. Angola (left Jan 2024) not in pool.
Iran and UAE joined BRICS on 1 Jan 2024. Other values correct.

KLM Asia is a wholly owned KLM (Netherlands) subsidiary flying KLM aircraft; it is nominally Taiwan-registered, so labelling it a non-NATO airline is contestable. Fly Lili (Romania), ETF Airways (Croatia), Air Albania correct.

PEV (HU), SRP (NO), TCE (RO), SXL (IE) are EEA; GVA, ZRH (CH) and test pool are not.
XAF (Cameroon, Gabon), SBD, LKR, GYD are currencies of Commonwealth members; CRC and test pool are not. BMD is a UK-territory currency, non-member reading defensible.

MQ (Martinique) is an integral part of France and the EU, and CX (Christmas Island) is an Australian external territory; both parents are G20 members, so their non-member labels are contestable. CA, BR, SA, AR correct. Near-duplicate of UN2 L4 (same field, same N_p TD, 5/7 shared N_t).

MQ and CX are integral territories of G20 members (France/EU, Australia), so their non-member labels are contestable. Also ZA's participation is disputed: the US excluded South Africa from its 2026 G20 presidency although membership was not formally revoked. Near-duplicate of UN1 L4.

French, Aragonese, Sardinian, Corsican are Italic (Romance); German and test pool are not.

SFP Primary Cluster Entry Points (CWE-897) = secondary cluster 1002 {489,491,493,500,531,568,580,582,583,608,766}; A and P_M members, N_p and test pool not (CWE 4.14).

Nigeria, Venezuela, Kuwait, Congo (2018) are OPEC; Chad and test pool are not. Angola left Jan 2024 but is not in pool.
